exact_remaining_gap: P44 needs an explicit 4x4 PPT state with SN>=3 (with a universal complex-SR2-nonnegative strict negative separator), or an unrestricted no-go (equivalently: every 2-positive map on M4 is decomposable). NEITHER is delivered. Within the original chart R_x, the following remain OPEN: large comparable moduli with p_z small relative to them, e.g. (V,V,V,1); the z=0 part with |v|>=|w| at large norm outside Theorems C and D, e.g. (0,V,V,0) and (V,V,V,0); and v-dominant points with u,z!=0. In these the known families have nonzero leading means (residue obstruction) or costs growing like the norm squared. No chart member is known to be SN3. The chart range is SR2-spanned everywhere (Part6 Y5), so any SN3 member would need a non-range witness.
